protocol:
1. A rack of tubes is retrieved from a cold storage unit using an orange cryogenic glove.
2. A beaker with a frosted exterior is handled next to a blue ice bucket containing dry ice.
3. Small, white-capped tubes are selected from a gridded freezer storage box.
4. A vertical gel electrophoresis cassette is inserted into the green running module of the electrophoresis tank.
5. A smartphone is attached to a flexible red-and-black tripod to film the procedure.
6. A liquid sample is loaded into a well of the vertical gel using a micropipette.
7. A handwritten laboratory notebook is consulted on the bench.
8. A white cardboard box with a yellow label is retrieved from a laboratory freezer.
